test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: R 4 is related to P 2 in a certain way. In the same way, F 7 is related to D 5. To which of the following is Z 8 related following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] **Logic :** • **Letter -** 2 is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series. • **Digit -** 2 is subtracted. ​So, • R 4 is related to P 2
